quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is approaching with its siren and flashing lights while you are crossing an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop immediately in the intersection until it passes.
Pull to the right of the intersection and stop.
Continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue through the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.
questions.explanation: If you are in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches with flashing lights or a siren, finish crossing the intersection. Then drive to the right and stop. You must yield to police cars, fire trucks, ambulances, and other emergency vehicles using sirens or flashing lights.

questions.question: Which of these is illegal?

options.text: Pass in any marked no passing zone.
Pass within 300 feet of a railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass in any marked no passing zone.
questions.explanation: Passing is illegal in many places. You cannot pass within 100 feet of a railroad crossing, within 100 feet of an intersection, or in any marked no passing zone.

questions.question: How long will your license be suspended if you refuse a chemical test when an officer asks for one?
questions.explanation: Nebraska has an Implied Consent Law. By driving in the state, you agree to take a chemical test if a police officer asks you to. If you refuse, your license can be suspended for one year.

questions.question: An oncoming driver is not dimming their high beams. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the approaching vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver does not dim their high beams, look toward the right side of the road. This will keep you from being blinded and will help you see the road well enough to stay in your lane until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at a low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At this type of railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for any trains and be ready to stop. Never try to go faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: You hear a siren nearby but cannot see the emergency vehicle yet. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving until you see the vehicle.
Pull to the curb and check if the vehicle is on your street.
Slow down. Do not stop until you see the vehicle.
Speed up and turn at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the curb and check if the vehicle is on your street.
questions.explanation: If you hear a siren or air horn but do not know where the emergency vehicle is, safely pull to the right side of the road and stop. Wait until you are sure it is not coming toward you.

questions.question: A driver's license is a:
questions.explanation: Driving is a privilege, not a right. All drivers must help keep roads safe. If you misuse this privilege, it can be taken away.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows for turning from specific lanes. What does a solid yellow arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a yellow circular traffic light.
Drivers may turn in the direction of the arrow.
A green arrow is about to appear.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow has the same meaning as a yellow traffic light. When you see a solid yellow arrow, slow down and prepare for a red light.

questions.question: Another driver is passing you in a no passing zone. What should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed and position the same.
Slow down to help the other driver safely return to their lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to help the other driver safely return to their lane.
questions.explanation: Help the passing vehicle return to the lane as easily as possible. This helps both of you avoid dangers ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for road hazards. This sign warns drivers that traffic is merging from the right. Prepare to let merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: How do you make room for cars entering the freeway?

options.text: Keep your speed and position the same.

questions.explanation: Make space for cars entering the freeway. Change lanes if you can to create a gap. If you cannot change lanes, slow down to let them merge safely.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Where should your car be after the turn?

options.text: In the center of the street.
In the lane with the least traffic.

questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, complete the turn into the left lane. This is closest to the lane you just left.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Nebraska law says you must report a crash within ____ if anyone is hurt or killed, or if damage exceeds ____ for any vehicle or property.
questions.explanation: Report a crash to the Department of Roads within 10 days if anyone is hurt or killed, or if property damage is more than $1,000.

questions.question: You are waiting in an intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so drivers will let you through.
Drive around a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn. If a car hits you from behind, this keeps you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Never park within ____ of a fire hydrant.
questions.explanation: You cannot park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. Only park where it is safe and legal.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass traffic going the same direction.

questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed, but solid yellow lines cannot. You can only cross a solid yellow line when you are turning.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in a business district if no other sign is posted?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in a business district is 20 miles per hour unless a different speed limit is posted. Follow any posted signs.

questions.question: A traffic signal is broken and no officer is there. What should you do?

options.text: Treat it like a yield sign intersection.
Treat it like an all-way stop.
Let drivers on major streets go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like an all-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic signal is broken and no officer is present, treat the intersection as an all-way stop. Be ready to yield and avoid accidents.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and turn your front wheels:
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn your wheels away from the curb. When parking uphill without a curb or parking downhill, turn your wheels toward the curb or road edge.

questions.question: Signal your intent to turn at least ____ feet before you turn.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn. This gives other drivers time to react safely to your movements.

questions.question: A vehicle's stopping distance does NOT depend on:
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road condition, and speed. The time of day itself does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: If you get 12 points on your license in two years, your license will be revoked for ____ months.
questions.explanation: Getting 12 violation points in two years results in automatic license revocation for six months.

questions.question: A broken yellow centerline means:

options.text: You can pass on the right if the way is clear.
You can pass on the left if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left if the way is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline lets you cross to pass another vehicle on the left if no traffic is coming. Never cross a solid yellow centerline to pass.
